title: Sales agent: semantic model for Dynamics 365 and Salesforce CRM data
summary: The briefing passes: its configuration paths, licensing options and rollout dates are supported, and the cited pages opened successfully. Two minor qualifications should acknowledge conflicting Microsoft references about the Work IQ default and the Copilot licence requirement.

claims.claim: The documented Sales agent setup enables semantic modelling through the environment Work IQ setting.

claims.claim: For Dynamics 365 the model is automatically generated after the setting is enabled.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365: The model is automatically generated after you enable the setting.

claims.claim: For Salesforce the model is generated on the next metadata cache refresh.
claims.quote: Salesforce: The model isn't generated immediately after you enable the setting. It's generated on the next metadata cache refresh.
